summary: Iter 12 — Opportunity vibe + HD Radar zoom testing. BACKEND: 8/8 pytest PASS (vibes list has opportunity{amber,sparkles}; kauri /api/nearby returns 5 opportunity demo users Priya/Dev/Sana/Jade/Marco with public_summary + payment but never private_details; GET /api/opportunity/{priya_id} returns connected=false/private_details=null pre-match, and after POST /api/matches returns connected=true and unlocks the HR-help private text; PUT /api/users/me/vibe-details rejects 'selling a gun' with 400 prohibition message and accepts normal opportunity payloads). Backend restarted after tests to re-seed kauri to demo state. FRONTEND: Radar renders /(tabs)/index.tsx correctly for kauri with amber opportunity blips (Priya sparkle badge visible), amber '+3 Opportunity' cluster (radar-cluster-*), radar-blip-<id> testIDs for individuals, radar-zoom-in/out + radar-recentre buttons, radius rings, privacy pill 'Exact locations hidden'. /opportunity/{priya_id} deep-link works end-to-end: PUBLIC SUMMARY card, PRIVATE DETAILS locked card (testID private-locked) with 'Small business owner in the CBD.' bio + Report link, tapping 'Discuss Opportunity' creates the match and swaps in testID private-unlocked showing 'I run a small business and need practical HR help…' — full lock/unlock flow verified. /report shows all 5 new reasons (Scam, Misleading opportunity, Unsafe item or service, Illegal activity, Payment dispute). HD ZOOM works once the PingModal is dismissed: zoom-in click ×2 animates worldLayer to scale(1.5) then scale(2.25), tile img srcs now include https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/rastertiles/voyager/17/... (16 base z=16 + 56 new z=17 high-detail tiles) so streets stay sharp, and radar-blip pixel size stays exactly 42×42 (overlayLayer not scaled) — matches the 'worldLayer scales, overlayLayer stays 1x' architecture. Double-click on radar-map animates to scale(2). TWO BUGS FOUND — both frontend regressions caused by the auto-PingModal: (1) The PingModal auto-opens for the closest opportunity user (Priya, ping_title='Opportunity nearby ✨') as soon as the Radar tab mounts, and its full-viewport Modal backdrop swallows pointer events → radar-zoom-in / radar-zoom-out / double-click / individual blip tap ALL fail while the ping is on screen (scale stays at 1, tiles never upgrade to z=17, opportunity-preview never renders). Only after tapping ping-dismiss does the HD zoom + blip tap → opportunity-preview flow work. (2) On the Nearby tab, tapping the filter-opportunity chip highlights the chip amber but the list renders the empty state 'No one nearby right now' instead of the 5 opportunity users — reproducible whether Nearby is entered directly or via Radar → Nearby, and even after ping dismissal. Backend /api/nearby returns all 5 opportunity users at radius 500m, so the bug is in the client filter (app/(tabs)/nearby.tsx line 63: `nearby.filter((n) => n.vibe === filter)` — likely the local `nearby` list this tab uses is not the same set the radar receives, or opportunity users are dropped by an upstream filter/dedup). Push notifications remain intentionally MOCKED (in-app pings only) — not flagged.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal (transparent backdrop) auto-opens on Radar for the nearest opportunity user (Priya, 'Opportunity nearby ✨') and its rgba(15,23,42,0.45) backdrop intercepts all touches/clicks on the radar underneath. While the ping is visible, radar-zoom-in, radar-zoom-out, radar-recentre, double-click zoom and radar-blip-* taps are all swallowed by the modal backdrop — worldLayer transform stays at scale(1), no z=17 tiles load, and tapping a blip cannot open opportunity-preview. Repro: fresh kauri demo-login → land on Radar → PingModal appears within 1–2s → click radar-zoom-in twice → transform still 'scale(1)'. Dismissing the ping via ping-dismiss restores all radar interactivity. Fix likely needs Modal 'pointerEvents=box-none' on the backdrop or gating the auto-ping to fire only after a user gesture. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/PingModal.tsx:39-92.

filter-opportunity chip is present and toggles active state, but selecting it renders the empty state ('No one nearby right now') even though kauri's /api/nearby returns 5 opportunity users (Priya, Dev, Sana, Jade, Marco). All other vibe filters were not exhaustively tested but 'Opportunity' clearly filters everything out. Filter line: `nearby.filter((n) => n.vibe === filter)` at line 63 — either the local `nearby` array here excludes opportunity users, or the equality check is against a different key. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/nearby.tsx:63.

action_items: HIGH — Stop PingModal from swallowing radar interactions. Options: (a) render the sheet with `pointerEvents="box-none"` on the outer backdrop so only the sheet itself captures touches, (b) suppress the auto-ping while the user is on '/' (Radar) and only surface pings in the Pings tab / on non-map screens, or (c) delay the initial ping by 3–5s and cancel it as soon as the user taps a radar-blip / zoom control. Repro is 100% on a fresh demo-login.

HIGH — Fix Nearby tab 'Opportunity' filter. Investigate why `nearby.filter((n) => n.vibe === 'opportunity')` yields 0 rows while /api/nearby returns 5 with `vibe==='opportunity'`. Likely candidates: a mode/detail sub-filter dropping opportunity users (nearby.tsx:64 DETAIL_FILTERS), the parent context slicing to compatible-only, or a stale `data` memo. Add a testID on the FlatList / empty state to make future regression easier.
OPTIONAL (carry-over) — migrate deprecated shadow* style props in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to boxShadow.

rca_of_issue: Bug #1 (PingModal blocking radar): PingModal.tsx line 39 uses RN <Modal transparent animationType='slide'> without pointerEvents='box-none' on the backdrop. On web, this Modal renders a full-viewport overlay div that captures all pointer events even where the backdrop is transparent, so the underlying radar-zoom / blip Pressables receive no events until the modal is closed. The opportunity vibe (server.py:281) has ping_title='Opportunity nearby ✨', and Priya is the closest opportunity user for kauri, so this auto-ping fires immediately on Radar mount and blocks the entire new-in-iter-12 flow. Bug #2 (Nearby 'Opportunity' filter empty): app/(tabs)/nearby.tsx:63 filters purely by `n.vibe === filter`, which should work — but the resulting list is empty despite /api/nearby returning 5 opportunity users. Likely an upstream context/list transform (see AppContext.nearby population or a compatible-only slicing) is stripping opportunity vibes on the client. Reproducible on both direct /nearby load and post-radar navigation.
